assertions.text: The answer concludes the bypass is offered and asks the user via AskUserQuestion
The approval shows the PR number, the head SHA, the version change ty 0.0.71 to 0.0.84, the classifier summary and the full reason text built from the template
The user is told that approving posts a public, permanent attestation comment and applies a label before merge-pr's own merge confirmation, and that declining that confirmation does not undo them
The answer mentions that the `s: codex review bypassed` label must already exist
The head SHA is re-read immediately before invoking Skill(merge-pr), and a difference voids the approval
Skill(merge-pr) is invoked with the PR number and --bypass-codex-review plus the reason

The answer performs the SHA comparison checkpoint at merge-pr's step 4(b) using the SHA resolved before the marker write, and adds no Bash call of its own between merge-pr's marker write and its comment
The skill asks no separate merge question of its own and does not post the attestation comment itself
